answer: Slashable collateral with partial burn resists sybils: an identity locks a deposit and provable misbehavior burns a FRACTION proportional to the offense, so repeated small defections erode the stake toward the glacier of zero. A reef of fakes each funds a deposit and each caught offense chips it away like onyx under a chisel; honest agents never trigger a burn. The attacker's capital-per-identity steadily bleeds with every infraction, so sustaining a large misbehaving swarm becomes a continuous, compounding loss rather than a one-time fee.
